letter.to_name: OU Health - University of Oklahoma Medical Center
letter.to_address: OU Health, Patient Financial Services, 700 NE 13th St, Oklahoma City, OK 73104
letter.re_line: Re: Account FB-2026-000004 - Statement dated 2026-09-11 - Dispute of visit-level charge, $489.70 at issue
letter.body:
Dear Patient Financial Services,

I am writing to dispute a charge on my statement dated 2026-09-11 before the payment due date of 2026-10-11. I understand that submitting this written dispute before that date keeps my account out of collections while the matter is reviewed.

The charge in question is on line 1 of my bill: code 99285, Emergency Department Visit for Life-Threatening or High Severity, billed at a list charge before discount of $6,795.00, with a your price (cash) of $679.50. This matches row 4045 in your posted price file, as required to be published under 45 CFR 180.50.

My concern is the difference between code 99285 (your price $679.50, row 4045) and the next level down, code 99283, EMERGENCY DEPARTMENT VISIT FOR PROBLEM OF MODERATE SEVERITY (your price $189.80, file line 4688). That is a difference of $489.70 in cash price - the amount at stake in this dispute.

I am not asserting that the visit level is wrong. I am asking that your billing team review the visit summary and clinical documentation from my encounter and confirm that the level of service recorded there supports a billing level of 99285 rather than 99283. If the documentation does support 99285, I would appreciate a brief written explanation of why. If it does not, I ask that the charge be corrected to 99283 and that a revised statement showing the updated your price be sent to me.

Please respond in writing by 2026-10-11.

Thank you for your time and attention to this matter.

Sincerely,
Morgan Placeholder

Sources:
- The hospital's own standard-charges file, row 4045: 99285 EMERGENCY DEPARTMENT VISIT FOR LIFE THREATENING OR FUNCTIONING SEVERITY, posted gross $6,795.00, discounted cash price $679.50 (file fetched 2026-09-13). https://apim.services.craneware.com/api-pricing-transparency/api/public/ebdcd27316bbcd47fb02c60d601d05cc/charges/mrf
- 45 CFR 180.50 requires this hospital to publish its standard charges, including the discounted cash price, in a machine-readable file. https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-45/part-180
